title: helianthemum lavandulifolium f. stoechadifolium
intro: Helianthemum lavandulifolium f. stoechadifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a shrubby perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rockrose include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial effects.
